entities.summary: Prince Christian of Hesse-Philippsthal-Barchfeld was a member of the House of Hesse-Philippsthal-Barchfeld and a German naval officer until he resigned his commission during the First World War in protest at Germany's policy of unrestricted submarine warfare.
